# Khoobsurati (parlour.wtf)

> A single-page ambient site: one illustrated ladies' parlour, a live
> "online now" counter, and a looping 90s Bollywood playlist that plays
> in the browser — background noise like the radio at your neighbourhood
> parlour. Not a company, a streaming service, or a business — a hobby
> project built and run by one person, with nothing for sale.

Khoobsurati doesn't host any audio. Playback happens through YouTube's
embedded player, and the same tracks are linked out to curated Spotify
and YouTube Music playlists. The "online now" counter is a shared-radio
illusion: everyone with the page open is, roughly, hearing the same song
at the same time.

## Pages

- [Home](https://parlour.wtf/): the player, the currently playing track, and the live listener count
- [About](https://parlour.wtf/about): what Khoobsurati is and isn't, and who runs it
- [Contact](https://parlour.wtf/contact): how to reach the operator
- [Privacy Policy](https://parlour.wtf/privacy)
- [Terms & Conditions](https://parlour.wtf/terms)

## Notes

- One-person hobby project — no accounts, no sign-up, no algorithm.
